title: Customers Who Bought All Products
rawStatement: missing: not in local-reference/leetcode/raw (index marks Missing)
summary: Return customer_id for every customer whose purchases cover every product_key listed in Product. Repeated purchases of one product do not count toward another.
inputFormat: Customer(customer_id, product_key): purchase rows, may repeat. Product(product_key): one row per listed product.
outputFormat: One column customer_id; one row per qualifying customer.
tieRules: Not applicable: each customer appears once.
edgeRules: Duplicate purchases never substitute for a missing product. Customers who bought nothing do not qualify unless Product is empty (not stated).
